# l3-schemas

Knowledge-graph layer L3, version 3.0: the FHIR conformance and knowledge artefacts an IG publishes (PlanDefinition, ActivityDefinition, Library and its CQL, Measure, Questionnaire, StructureMap, StructureDefinition and profiles, ValueSet, CodeSystem, ConceptMap, ActorDefinition, Requirements), elaborating L2's external artefact. Imports L2-DMN. `l3.ts` is the layer as migrated from WHO smart-kg 3f5e477, typed; `index.ts` exports it to the engine in `../../L1/schemas/`, and `generated/` holds the ontology JSON and the JSON-LD context. The FSH goes to the IG's `input/fsh/`.

Part of [SMART Base](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `l3-schemas`, holding `schemas`, `code`.
